title: Apollo-managed entity to finance about $40 billion of GPU pods for SpaceX via master finance lease

sources.quote: The Company expects aggregate principal payments under the lease schedules over their respective terms to total approximately $40 billion.

explain: SpaceX signed a binding commitment letter on October 24 for a lease in which an entity managed by Apollo buys GPU pods and leases them to SpaceX for its data centers. SpaceX expects lease payments of about $40 billion over the terms; the lease is not yet signed and is expected to close before year end, with deliveries starting in the first half of 2027.
